dashboard.label: Discovery Inventory
dashboard.description: CMDB-oriented subnet-discovery evidence from Ping Monitor v5.10+. “Not observed” means only that an IP did not answer that discovery scan; it is not a health, outage, or decommissioning conclusion.

search.query: | inputlookup ping_monitor_settings_lookup | search _key="global" | head 1 | append [| makeresults | eval index="ping", sourcetype="ping_monitor"] | head 1 | eval pm_index=if(isnull(index) OR index=="", "ping", index) | eval pm_sourcetype=if(isnull(sourcetype) OR sourcetype=="", "ping_monitor", sourcetype)
| where isnotnull(target_network) AND target_network!="" | stats count by target_network | fields target_network | sort target_network

choice.value: Not observed in latest applicable scan

html.p: Signal interpretation: Discovery proves that an address answered an ICMP subnet scan at a point in time. “Not observed” is retained as evidence, but it never becomes “down.” Use the monitoring dashboards for collector-confirmed health and SLA evaluation.

search.query: | search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | stats dc(scan_id) AS scans
| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | stats count AS assets
| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | where discovery_observed=1 | stats count AS observed
| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | where discovery_observed=0 | stats count AS not_observed

| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | search (evidence_status="$evidence_filter$" OR "$evidence_filter$"="*") | search (discovery_review_state="$review_filter$" OR "$review_filter$"="*") | search endpoint_key="*$discovery_search$*" OR hostname="*$discovery_search$*" OR fqdn="*$discovery_search$*" OR target_ip="*$discovery_search$*" OR vendor="*$discovery_search$*" OR device="*$discovery_search$*" | eval fqdn=coalesce(fqdn, "Not resolved"), hostname=coalesce(hostname, "Unknown"), group=coalesce(group, "Unassigned"), dns_status=coalesce(dns_status, "unknown"), asset_id=coalesce(asset_id, ""), classification_source=coalesce(classification_source, "manual/legacy"), discovery_probe_backend=coalesce(discovery_probe_backend, "legacy/unknown"), discovery_latency_display=case(lower(tostring(discovery_latency_censored)) IN ("true","1","t") AND isnotnull(discovery_latency_upper_bound_ms), "<".discovery_latency_upper_bound_ms, isnotnull(discovery_latency_ms), tostring(discovery_latency_ms), true(), "Unavailable") | table endpoint_key, asset_id, target_ip, hostname, fqdn, discovery_review_state, discovery_reviewed_at, discovery_review_note, evidence_status, discovery_delta_status, dns_evidence, dns_status, discovery_latency_display, discovery_probe_backend, discovery_latency_source, target_network, subnet_name, subnet_vlan, subnet_location, routing_domain, dynamic_address, group, entitytype, device, vendor, device_mode, alerting_enabled, classification_source, first_observed_human, last_observed_human, last_evidence_human, last_scan_id | rename endpoint_key AS "Endpoint ID", asset_id AS "Asset ID", target_ip AS "IP Address", hostname AS "Hostname", fqdn AS "FQDN", discovery_review_state AS "Review State", discovery_reviewed_at AS "Reviewed At", discovery_review_note AS "Review Note", evidence_status AS "Discovery Evidence", discovery_delta_status AS "Change", dns_evidence AS "DNS Evidence", dns_status AS "DNS Status", discovery_latency_display AS "Discovery Latency (ms)", discovery_probe_backend AS "Probe Backend", discovery_latency_source AS "Latency Source", target_network AS "Scan Target", subnet_name AS "Subnet Name", subnet_vlan AS "VLAN", subnet_location AS "Subnet Location", routing_domain AS "Routing Domain", dynamic_address AS "Dynamic Address", group AS "Group", entitytype AS "Entity Type", device AS "Device", vendor AS "Vendor", device_mode AS "Mode", alerting_enabled AS "Alerting Enabled", classification_source AS "Classification Source", first_observed_human AS "First Observed", last_observed_human AS "Last Observed", last_evidence_human AS "Last Evidence", last_scan_id AS "Last Scan ID" | sort "Discovery Evidence", "IP Address"

| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | eval completed=strftime(_time, "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), baseline=if(lower(tostring(baseline_available)) IN ("true","1","t"), "Compared with prior scan", "Initial baseline") | eval discovery_engine=coalesce(discovery_engine, "powershell_legacy"), hosts_indeterminate=coalesce(hosts_indeterminate, 0) | table completed, target_network, schedule_id, discovery_engine, probe_backends, requested_concurrency, probe_workers, dns_workers, hosts_considered, hosts_probed, endpoints_observed, hosts_not_observed, hosts_indeterminate, dns_forward_confirmed, dns_ptr_only, dns_unresolved, new_endpoints, missing_endpoints, unchanged_endpoints, scan_duration_ms, baseline, scan_id | rename completed AS "Completed", target_network AS "Scan Target", schedule_id AS "Schedule", discovery_engine AS "Engine", probe_backends AS "Probe Backends", requested_concurrency AS "Workers Requested", probe_workers AS "ICMP Workers Used", dns_workers AS "DNS Workers Used", hosts_considered AS "Hosts Considered", hosts_probed AS "Hosts Probed", endpoints_observed AS "Observed", hosts_not_observed AS "No ICMP Observation", hosts_indeterminate AS "Indeterminate", dns_forward_confirmed AS "DNS Confirmed", dns_ptr_only AS "PTR Only", dns_unresolved AS "DNS Unresolved", new_endpoints AS "New", missing_endpoints AS "Not Observed vs Prior", unchanged_endpoints AS "Unchanged", scan_duration_ms AS "Duration (ms)", baseline AS "Comparison", scan_id AS "Scan ID" | sort - "Completed"
| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | stats count by dns_evidence
| search (target_network="$target_filter$" OR "$target_filter$"="*") | chart count over target_network by evidence_status
